# Teen Patti Master Hub (techtonis.com)

> Independent guides to Indian card games: Teen Patti Master, Teen Patti Gold, Rummy, Yono and related apps. Covers rules, hand rankings, APK installation, bonuses, payments and responsible play. 18+ only. Real-money gaming may be restricted in some Indian states.
